description: Stage 1 of the Briefing Hub: full ingest-to-purge flow self-hosted on Coolify. Strips the Cloudflare/vinext stack and replaces it with standard Next.js + SQLite. Agents POST structured JSON briefings; user reviews card-by-card and explicitly purges on completion.

userStories.title: Remove Cloudflare stack, switch to standard Next.js
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the project to run as a standard Node.js Next.js app so it can be containerized and deployed on Coolify.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json scripts changed to: dev='next dev', build='next build', start='next start', test='tsc --noEmit'
vinext, wrangler, @cloudflare/vite-plugin removed from dependencies
worker/index.ts deleted
.openai/hosting.json deleted
vite.config.ts deleted (vinext-specific)
build/sites-vite-plugin.ts deleted
next.config.ts kept but cleared of any vinext/cloudflare options
drizzle.config.ts updated to use sqlite dialect pointing to ./data/briefings.db
next dev starts without errors
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Define the JSON briefing schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a documented JSON schema for briefings so agents know exactly what to POST and the server can validate incoming data.
acceptanceCriteria: src/schema/briefing.schema.json exists with JSON Schema Draft-07
Schema requires at top level: title (string), source (object with name, mark, tone), cards (array, minItems 1)
Each card requires: type (enum: action|information|warning|result), priority (enum: critical|high|medium|low), title (string), summary (string), body (array of strings), meta (string)
Each card allows optional: action_label (string), reference (string)
examples/sample-briefing.json exists with a valid 2-card briefing
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Define the database schema (Drizzle + SQLite)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need Drizzle table definitions for briefings, cards, and agent sources so the app has a durable data layer.
acceptanceCriteria: db/schema.ts defines briefings table with columns: id (integer pk), slug (text unique not null), title (text), source_name (text), source_mark (text), source_tone (text), status (text: unread|in_progress|reviewed|completed|deleted, default unread), json_path (text), created_at (integer timestamp), reviewed_at (integer nullable), completed_at (integer nullable)

db/schema.ts defines cards table with columns: id (integer pk), briefing_id (integer FK→briefings.id), position (integer), type (text), priority (text), title (text nullable), summary (text nullable), body (text nullable, JSON array), meta (text), action_label (text nullable), reference (text nullable), status (text: unread|reviewed|actioned, default unread), action_choice (text nullable), reviewed_at (integer nullable)

db/schema.ts defines agent_sources table with columns: id (integer pk), name (text unique not null), mark (text), tone (text), last_briefing_at (integer nullable), briefings_this_week (integer default 0), unread_count (integer default 0)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Database initialization and connection
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the SQLite database to auto-initialize on first run so no manual setup is required.
acceptanceCriteria: db/index.ts removed of all cloudflare:workers imports
db/index.ts exports getDb() using better-sqlite3 + drizzle-orm/better-sqlite3
better-sqlite3 and @types/better-sqlite3 added to package.json dependencies
getDb() reads DATA_DIR env var (default: ./data) and opens DATA_DIR/briefings.db
On first call, all three tables are created via sql`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` or drizzle migrate
DATA_DIR folders (briefings/, inbox/, processed/, failed/) are created if missing
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Health check API endpoint
userStories.description: As Coolify, I need a health check endpoint so the container readiness can be verified.
acceptanceCriteria: app/api/health/route.ts exports GET handler
Returns JSON { ok: true, db: 'connected' } with status 200 when getDb() succeeds
Returns JSON { ok: false, db: 'error' } with status 503 if getDb() throws
curl http://localhost:3000/api/health returns 200
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: CSPRNG slug generator utility
userStories.description: As the ingest layer, I need a cryptographically random URL-safe slug so briefings get unguessable identifiers.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/slug.ts exports generateSlug(): string
Uses crypto.randomBytes(9).toString('base64url') or equivalent to produce at least 12 URL-safe characters
No hyphens, slashes, or plus signs in output (base64url encoding)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Shared ingest logic
userStories.description: As the ingest API and inbox watcher, I need a shared function that validates, stores, and indexes a briefing JSON payload.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/ingest.ts exports ingestBriefing(payload: unknown): Promise<{ slug: string; cardCount: number }>
Validates payload against src/schema/briefing.schema.json using ajv; throws with validation errors on failure
Generates a slug, writes JSON to DATA_DIR/briefings/<slug>.json
Inserts one row into briefings table and one row per card into cards table
Upserts agent_sources row: insert on conflict(name) do update last_briefing_at, unread_count+1
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Ingest API endpoint
userStories.description: As an agent, I want to POST a briefing JSON to the server so it appears in the user's inbox.
acceptanceCriteria: app/api/ingest/route.ts exports POST handler
Returns 401 if Authorization header is missing or does not match Bearer <BRIEFING_HUB_API_KEY>
Returns 400 with { ok: false, errors: [...] } if payload fails schema validation
Calls ingestBriefing() on valid payload
Returns 200 with { ok: true, slug: string, card_count: number } on success
Returns 500 with { ok: false, error: 'Internal error' } (no sensitive detail) on unexpected errors
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: File system inbox watcher
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to drop a JSON file into /data/inbox/ and have it ingested automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/inbox-watcher.ts exports startInboxWatcher(): void
Watches DATA_DIR/inbox/ using fs.watch() for new .json files
On new file: reads content, calls ingestBriefing(), moves file to DATA_DIR/processed/<filename> on success
On validation or ingest error: moves file to DATA_DIR/failed/<filename>, logs error to console
instrumentation.ts (Next.js instrumentation hook) exists and calls startInboxWatcher() in the register() function
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: List briefings API
userStories.description: As the frontend, I need to fetch the list of active briefings for the inbox and history views.
acceptanceCriteria: app/api/briefings/route.ts exports GET handler
Returns { briefings: [...] } ordered by created_at DESC
Each item shape: { slug, title, source: { name, mark, tone }, status, card_count, unread_count, created_at }
Excludes rows where status='deleted'
Includes rows where status='completed' (history view needs these)
Returns { briefings: [] } if no rows exist
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Get single briefing API
userStories.description: As the frontend, I need to fetch a briefing and all its cards for the briefing session view.
acceptanceCriteria: app/api/briefings/[slug]/route.ts exports GET handler
Returns 404 JSON if slug not found or status='deleted'
Returns briefing + ordered cards: { slug, title, source, status, created_at, cards: [{ id, position, type, priority, title, summary, body, meta, action_label, reference, status, action_choice }] }
If briefing status is 'unread', updates it to 'in_progress' before returning
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Card review and action API
userStories.description: As the frontend, I need to record the user's decision on each card.
acceptanceCriteria: app/api/cards/[id]/route.ts exports PATCH handler
Accepts body { status: 'reviewed' } or { status: 'actioned', action_choice: string }
Returns 400 if status is not 'reviewed' or 'actioned'
Returns 404 if card id not found
Updates card status, action_choice (if actioned), and reviewed_at timestamp
Returns { ok: true }
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Briefing completion API with cascading purge
userStories.description: As the frontend, I need to mark a briefing as done and purge all content so the security guarantee is real.
acceptanceCriteria: app/api/briefings/[slug]/complete/route.ts exports POST handler
Returns 404 if slug not found

Purge sequence: (1) delete DATA_DIR/briefings/<slug>.json (no error if missing), (2) set cards title/summary/body/action_label/reference to null in DB, (3) set briefing status='deleted' and completed_at=now
All purge steps complete before response is sent
Returns { ok: true, actions_count: N } where N = count of cards with status='actioned'
After completion GET /api/briefings/:slug returns 404
Briefing row remains in DB as tombstone with status='deleted' and no content
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Sources API
userStories.description: As the frontend, I need to fetch the list of agent sources that have published briefings.
acceptanceCriteria: app/api/sources/route.ts exports GET handler
Returns { sources: [...] } ordered by last_briefing_at DESC nulls last
Each item: { id, name, mark, tone, last_briefing_at, briefings_this_week, unread_count }
Returns { sources: [] } if no sources exist
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Wire inbox view to real data
userStories.description: As the user, I want the inbox to show my actual briefings instead of hardcoded mock data.
acceptanceCriteria: InboxView component fetches from GET /api/briefings on mount using useEffect + fetch
Hero callout shows real count of unread/in_progress briefings (the '03' number becomes dynamic)
Briefing list renders real briefings from API; each row shows source mark, source tone, title, created_at, and unread card count
Date in greeting is dynamic: new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' })
'Interactive prototype' pill removed from topbar
Loading skeleton or spinner shown while fetching
Empty state shown if briefings array is empty: 'Your agents have nothing to report yet.'
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Wire briefing session to real data
userStories.description: As the user, I want the briefing session to show real cards from a selected briefing and record my decisions to the server.
acceptanceCriteria: InboxView passes the selected briefing slug to Home so BriefingView can fetch it
BriefingView fetches from GET /api/briefings/:slug on mount
Cards array is driven by API response (not hardcoded)
Reviewed action calls PATCH /api/cards/:id with { status: 'reviewed' }
Needs-action choice calls PATCH /api/cards/:id with { status: 'actioned', action_choice: label }
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Wire completion to real purge API
userStories.description: As the user, I want 'Mark done & delete' to actually purge the briefing on the server.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Mark done & delete' button calls POST /api/briefings/:slug/complete
Deleted/success screen only shown after API responds { ok: true }
If API returns error, an inline error message is shown and the briefing is not marked deleted in UI
After successful purge, navigating back to inbox no longer shows the briefing
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Wire history and sources views to real data
userStories.description: As the user, I want the history and sources views to show real data instead of hardcoded arrays.
acceptanceCriteria: HistoryView fetches from GET /api/briefings on mount
Filter buttons (All / Active / Completed / Needs action) filter the list client-side
Completed rows show status pill 'Completed — content deleted' and have no clickable arrow
Active rows show status pill 'Reviewed — content active' and link to the briefing session
SourcesView fetches from GET /api/sources on mount
Each source card renders real name, mark, tone, last_briefing_at, unread_count, briefings_this_week
Empty state shown in SourcesView if sources array is empty

userStories.title: Docker packaging
userStories.description: As a Coolify operator, I need a Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml so the app deploys as a container.
acceptanceCriteria: Dockerfile uses multi-stage build: stage 1 (node:22-slim + build-essential) installs deps and runs next build; stage 2 (node:22-slim) copies .next/standalone output
next.config.ts sets output: 'standalone'
Final image runs node server.js on port 3000
BRIEFING_HUB_API_KEY and DATA_DIR accepted as ENV / ARG
VOLUME /data declared in Dockerfile
docker-compose.yml defines one service with volume mount ./data:/data and env_file: .env.example
.env.example exists with BRIEFING_HUB_API_KEY=change_me_40_chars and DATA_DIR=/data
docker build -t briefing-hub . completes without errors
Typecheck passes
